effective_date_source_text: Effective for service rendered on and after January 15, 2025
notes: DEP NC Original Leaf No. 672, Clean Energy Impact Rider CEI. Price per 250 kWh block is set annually and posted on the website - NOT printed. Expected zero charges. Distractors: 'administrative fee not to exceed 20%' (a cap, not a charge), 250 kWh block size, 1,000 kWh per REC, 30 days notice, 12 months.
